arms.R6: brute.driftsound.DriftSoundLearner(rule="RO"), subclass of the v0.5.0 RegionBruteLearner: Y1k certification on RegionK, plus RECENCY-OPENED EDGES: let s* be the most recent step with residual surprise > tau6/2 or a window-tier event; if s* is within the last W=8 steps, every transition edge (q,a) of every region machine whose confirming traversals all lie before s* is treated as UNKNOWN in the fibre_union/y1k check (unknown edges open to every code at every fibre state, not only the current one). Otherwise identical to A5 (LU-R, alarm, resume). Purpose: remove stale post-drift certificates (G3-prime).
arms.C6: brute.driftsound.DriftSoundLearner(rule="CT"): COVERAGE-TRACKED certification: certify code c for action a if EITHER the A5 Y1k check certifies c, OR all of: (i) the tracked-state projection of the full-history region (v0.2.0 / A2 rule) is the single code c, (ii) no residual surprise > tau6/2, no window-tier event and no contradiction in the session so far, (iii) t >= burn_in. Purpose: recover A2 coverage in-family (G6b) while keeping Y1k after any surprising evidence.
arms.A5: frozen v0.5.0 production learner (brute.region_learner.RegionBruteLearner, policy LU-R), control and v0.90-control source
arms.A4: frozen brute.resume.ResumeBruteLearner (v0.4.0) run through frozen trajectory code; v0.90 control for G3-prime (same definition as 007)
arms.B5: frozen v0.5.0 brute.breadth.BreadthBruteLearner (policy LU-R) on breadth worlds; GX2-prime subject
arms.BR6: R6 rule on breadth worlds (tau7 in place of tau6)
arms.BC6: C6 rule on breadth worlds (tau7 in place of tau6)

rule_constants_frozen.note: tau6/2 (2x2) and tau7/2 (breadth) are fixed here; they are NOT tuned on any data. No other free parameter exists in R6/C6.

xcheck_backend.file: brute/xcheck_sat.py (no import of brute/region.py, brute/geometry.py or any enumeration code)
xcheck_backend.encoding: different from RegionK: direct (non-one-hot) transition variables T[q][a][r] with at-most-one via sequential counter, emission variables E[q][c] with exactly-one via pairwise, NO canonical first-visit symmetry breaking, state path variables S[t][q]; region re-derived from the raw (action, mask) evidence
xcheck_backend.solver: CaDiCaL 1.9.5 via python-sat (pysat solver name cadical195); RegionK uses Glucose3
per_query: uniqueness of the certified code c: UNSAT of (region AND fibre state predicts code != c under action a) proves the projection is {c} — a proof, not an enumeration
abstention: two SAT models predicting different codes; each model is decoded to an explicit machine and REPLAYED in plain Python against the evidence (witness check independent of either encoding)
status/reason/certificate, Y1k decision, margin support, saturation
xcheck_backend.budget: per query 2,000,000 conflicts (pysat conf_budget / solve_limited); a query hitting the budget makes the step UNCHECKED (counted, never a mismatch, never a pass)
xcheck_backend.note: the decision-level fields (status, reason, certificate, Y1k decision, support sets) are compared; probabilities, surprise and LU-R scores are recomputed from the re-derived support sets by experiments/v060_xcheck.py

quantities: |R_t|: number of canonical (first-visit-named) machines in the family region (<=4 for 2x2) consistent with the evidence at step t
per action a and code c: projected count of the fibre-prediction projection (number of (machine, fibre state) pairs predicting c)
modelcount.primary_counter: pyganak==2.8.0 (exact projected model counting) on the RegionK CNF with symmetry breaking, projection set = the machine variables (d, e)
modelcount.independent_check: blocking-clause enumeration on the xcheck encoding with CaDiCaL (count of distinct projected models), capped at 10^4 models
modelcount.guarantee_labelling: if the pinned counter version documents a probabilistic (not exact) guarantee, its counts are labelled Inferred, not Exact, and only the cross-check agreement decides GMC
modelcount.use: reporting only: counts are NEVER used by any certification, policy, alarm or experiment decision in v0.6.0

budget_rule_modelcount.per_count: 10 s wall-clock (counter timeout) per count; timeout or error => that count is UNKNOWN, recorded with reason, never imputed
budget_rule_modelcount.per_case: at most 120 s of counting per case; remaining sampled steps of that case are UNKNOWN (budget)
budget_rule_modelcount.total: study-wide counting wall-clock <= 6 h; counting stops at the cap and the rest are UNKNOWN
budget_rule_modelcount.dependency: if pyganak==2.8.0 cannot be installed/imported on Python 3.13.5 at implementation time, every count is UNKNOWN (reason: counter unavailable) and the fallback applies; no other exact counter is substituted after freeze without a deviation entry

fallback_modelcount: If GMC fails or the counter is unavailable: (1) GMC is published as FAIL/INFEASIBLE with the measured fraction; (2) reported region sizes fall back to the blocking-clause count where <= 10^4 (Exact, censored as ">10^4" otherwise) and to pyapproxmc==4.4.0 estimates (epsilon=0.8, delta=0.2) labelled Inferred (approximate, with its PAC bound) — never presented as exact; (3) the "Exact or approximate #SAT" item stays Open; (4) no v0.6.0 claim depends on counts.

metrics.false_certificates: certificate on (step, action) whose code differs from the realized code of that action (counterfactual actions evaluated on the world copy)
metrics.coverage: dual coverage as in study-006/007 (fraction of post-burn-in (step, action) pairs with a conditional certificate)
metrics.xcheck_checked_fraction: checked steps / all steps per breadth family per arm (steps excluded only by the xcheck conflict budget)
metrics.xcheck_mismatch: any decision-level field differing at a checked step
metrics.modelcount_coverage: fraction of sampled steps with a counted (non-UNKNOWN) |R_t|
metrics.modelcount_agreement: counts equal to the blocking-clause count where the latter is <= 10^4

scoring.soundness_counts: all steps incl. burn-in, every action (taken and counterfactual)
scoring.loss: -ln max(1e-12, p[actual]) on the full code
scoring.bootstrap: seed-clustered paired bootstrap (each seed = its 3 mask cases), 2000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20261026), percentile 2.5/97.5

GA1_drift_sound_and_coverage.threshold: PASS iff for at least ONE arm X in {R6, C6}: G1(X) PASS AND G2(X) PASS AND G3_prime(X) PASS AND G6b(X) PASS, all on the same held-out run. The passing arm(s) are named; both arms are reported.

G1_in_family_soundness.threshold: R6, C6 (2x2) and B5, BR6, BC6 (breadth): 0 false conditional and 0 false public certificates on every in-family case; all steps incl. burn-in, every action. No regression = same 0 as v0.5.0.

PASS iff (i) mismatching checked steps = 0, (ii) witness replays failing = 0, (iii) checked fraction >= 0.99 for EACH of big6, sens3, act3, ood6s3 and EACH of B5, BR6, BC6 separately (only the per-query conflict budget may exclude a step; excluded steps are counted and published), (iv) on steps where the frozen enumeration reference v050_reference.py also completes, xcheck and enumeration agree on all compared fields (0 disagreements).

GT1_verifier_parse_errors.threshold: scripts/verify_release_060.py wraps every artifact read (open, gzip, json.loads, schema/key access) so that any failure raises VerificationError. tests/test_release_060.py: for EVERY JSON artifact of results/study-008 plus RELEASE.json, SEAL and MANIFEST, each of 4 corruption modes (truncated to half, invalid UTF-8 byte, empty file, valid JSON with a required key deleted) must raise VerificationError; 0 other exception types; 0 silent passes. GMC_model_counting_feasibility.type: target (d); its result does not enter GA1 and no other gate depends on it
GMC_model_counting_feasibility.threshold: on the modelcount sample (every 4th post-burn-in step of every A5 in_family_original_2x2 case): (i) |R_t| counted (not UNKNOWN) on >= 95% of sampled steps under the budget rule, (ii) 0 disagreements with the independent blocking-clause count on every sampled step where that count is <= 10^4, (iii) the per-code projected counts sum consistency check (sum over codes of fibre-prediction counts >= |R_t|, equality where each fibre state predicts exactly one code) has 0 violations. GMC_model_counting_feasibility.prediction: Inferred: PASS on 2x2 (<=4-state regions are small); breadth largely UNKNOWN or censored (Open).

G4_public_safety.threshold: R6, C6, B5, BR6, BC6: 0 public certificates on ood5, drift4 and ood6s3; 0 wrong public certificates anywhere; no public certificate after the first alarm of a session

G5_false_alarm_limit.threshold: for EACH arm R6, C6, BR6, BC6 and EACH in-family family of its block: fraction of cases with >=1 RESIDUAL_SURPRISE alarm <= 0.05

G7_open_world.threshold: mean post-burn-in taken-action log-loss: R6, C6 <= ln 4 on ood5 and drift4; BR6, BC6 <= ln 8 on ood6s3; min probability >= eps/m everywhere (0.005 for 2x2, 0.0025 for 8 codes)

G9_retraction_resume.threshold: every resume (R6, C6, BR6, BC6) only after W=8 consecutive residuals <= tau with family and margin supported; no RESYNC_AMBIGUOUS forecast; retractions only at contradiction

G10_compute.threshold: every case of every block completes; production arms: forecasts with solver_unknown>0 <= 1% of forecasts per block

G11_second_implementation.threshold: experiments/v060_reference.py (same author, no brute import, committed before any v0.6.0 brute/ file) audits every R6, C6 trace (2x2 enumeration of the R6/C6 rules) and every BR6/BC6 trace up to its row budget 160000; report = COUNT of mismatching traces, must be 0; mutation test 20 injected single-field errors in 20 distinct traces (random.Random(20261026)) detected 20/20. Labelled "second implementation by the same author", never "independent".

G12_reproducibility.threshold: a second run of every case whose run index is divisible by 3 (2x2 and breadth) to a new path gives byte-identical scientific JSON (timing keys stripped); for GMC, re-counted sampled steps give identical counts (UNKNOWN allowed to differ only by timeout, reported)
